mandatory_semantic_conditions: Each ACCEPT binds only its exact LF declaration_digest and raw sha256, literal source path, unique ordered whole-line start/end markers and supplied range. Start is included and end excluded. No approved marker may widen or acquire a different digest without a new independent decision.

The declaration digest is SHA-256 of compact sorted JSON over exactly id, path, start, end, sha256, category, reason and source_evidence, using ensure_ascii=true and allow_nan=false. All 17 were independently recomputed. The final packet hash separately binds the supplied raw excerpts and coordinate metadata.

Historical meaning comes from each complete named audit subject, concrete source-line references, dimensional observations, proposed remedies and peer comparison, read in the original audit context. A heading, date, hash, BUILT/complete label or historical banner alone is insufficient.

The complete original source context must remain bound to the corresponding exact LF source hash below through the actual existing prepared acceptance/evidence machinery before a mechanism admits a span. Mere span equality or a freely supplied context-hash field is insufficient. If that binding is missing, changed or unverified, admission stays blocked despite this semantic ACCEPT.

A changed preamble or adjacent instruction that turns an unchanged record into current configuration or execution invalidates its historical-use premise. Recontextualized records need a fresh semantic decision, not automatic acceptance from matching interior bytes. Full-source hashes are context invariants, never whole-file exemptions: only the approved spans may be masked.

Every other span remains checked, including preceding inventories, live imports/selections/current-use text, following summaries, excluded end-marker sections, unknown fields or records and other cohort narratives. A neighboring accepted record must satisfy its separate decision.

These YAML-labelled records include informal or invalid pseudo-YAML. Preserve them as literal recorded text, including obsolete or unsafe recommendations. No valid-YAML claim, execution, silent repair, file read, profile operation, permission or endorsed remedy follows.

Raw admission must compare exact LF bytes without EOL conversion, alternate hashes or a parser-shape fallback. The reviewer's CRLF-to-LF comparison established representation equivalence only; it is not product admission logic. The proposed five per-file attribute declarations are not implemented or accepted by this review.

A whole-file/subtree/extension/cohort waiver, suppress-all census baseline, unapproved marker expansion or approval inherited by new record shapes is rejected. Source truth, source-era line accuracy, licenses, runtime behavior, P05 status and actor independence are not established by record shape.
Mechanism implementation, bound-context consumption, actual counterexample tests, fresh full-candidate review, mandatory QA/current-routing checks and release remain separate and unverified here.

counterexamples.status: Required discriminating semantic cases; NOT RUN against a classifier
all_entries: Add a current_use/import/selection key or 'Use /li:qa now' inside a record: changed raw bytes revoke that exact approval; no generic historical-record fallback.
Insert a current instruction after the closing fence but before the exclusive end: the raw span changes and is not approved.
Insert a current instruction before the start or after the exclusive end: it remains outside the mask; changed full-source context also requires fresh binding and semantic consideration.
Change only the preamble to designate the unchanged block as a live route/configuration source: matching span bytes must not clear the changed context.
Duplicate, nest or reorder whole-line markers, omit the end, widen the end into another record, or transplant the exact bytes to another path: no approval.
Change LF to CRLF, punctuation, source paths, old results, category, reason or source_evidence: neither the original CRLF decision nor a newly computed unapproved digest may be used.
Add a new record with the same headings/fields/date, or current prose in another field: no shape-based inheritance.
Preserve invalid historic pseudo-YAML literally; do not claim a successful parse or execute paths, tags, aliases, shell snippets or original recommendations.
